session_read: Pre-open quick sweep found the INDmoney snapshot materially lagging a real, broad AI-capex rally -- live quotes across 25+ of 33 holdings showed 2-11% gains the snapshot's own day-change field missed entirely. Two fresh catalyst-driven trims (MU, SKHY) and a fresh AMD-to-KLAC cluster rotation are now live proposals, all advisory, none executed. Two new cluster ladders (AI Power/Cooling/DC Infra, AI Memory/Storage) were built this session, ranking every held name against real bench candidates for the first time. Looking ahead: the next FOMC check lands 2026-09-17, GEV reports Q3 on 2026-10-21 (the read-through point for the whole AI Power cluster's leader call), and the AMD-to-KLAC and AVGO-to-LITE rotations stay live only as long as this run's cluster ladders keep ranking them that way.
